coloration._note: PACHY 2026-10-31 (owner: 'the color is off'): hue_deg was 355, read as +-355 deg (clamped to +-40), so wild animals rolled orange to purple hides; and a stripes pattern was drawn over the painted stripes. Now a small natural range and no extra stripes; the hide's own cream and dusty-pink stripes carry the look.

rig_note: Biped. Tripo v2 mesh (multiview from Codex views of the owner's sheet, standing pose), rigged by tools/gait/rig_biped.py with a hand-placed T. rex-style skeleton (Hips/Spine1/Chest/Neck1/Neck2/Head, Tail1-6, Thigh/Shin/Metatarsal/Toe, Arm/Forearm/Hand) and heat weights; Jaw by tools/jaw/add_jaw.py. Replaces the Velociraptor transplant whose warp put the spine 25 cm off the body and crumpled the legs (owner 2026-10-31: 'the legs are mangled').
prompt: Pachycephalosaurus from the owner's turnaround sheet (Armored Striped Dinosaur Turnaround Sheet): stocky biped, thick body, strong hind legs, short arms with three black claws, long stiff tail, bony pebbled dome skull ringed by cream spikes and knobs, small spikes down the snout, small beak-like mouth open, amber eyes, cream-white base with broad dusty-pink/red vertical stripes, pinkish-red scaly neck and back, tan scaly lower legs, dark claws. No saddle.

clips.attack_primary: dome butt: rock back, chin tucked so the dome faces the prey, drive the body forward off a planted step; the dome is the front-most point at the hit (0.42)
clips.attack_heavy: stomp: rears up on the left leg, right foot hauled high and held (telegraph), slammed down ahead (hit 0.72)
clips.kick: hip check: the rump and stiff tail slam round to the side and back at a prey behind it (hit 0.45)
clips.charge: head-down run-up, dome leading; the impact is the charge's body-slam shove
clips.alert: threat display: head lowered and dome presented, a stamp of the right foot, a snort

eyes.note: ray-cast onto the painted amber eye of the v2 mesh (symmetric), glTF Head-bone space

tactics._about: # ASSUMPTION (owner 2026-10-31: 'give it fight moves that suit a dome-headed brawler'): pack_mule's herd behaviour, display and head-down charge (the dome headbutt with knockback), plus at point blank a hip check (kick) when the prey is behind it, else a stomp (attack_heavy, its own cooldown), else a dome butt. Bigger shove than the other grazers: it is a head-butting specialist.
